_readme: Rambler: surveyed exterior footprint retained; estimated narrow pool courtyard, seven white-panel residential rows above a brick amenity base. Courtyard dimensions and details are visual estimates. Panel joints, vents, curtains and timber grooves use sign detail >= 0.6; structural glazing, furniture and pool geometry remain on phones.
